title: P1 quest talk response
description: result carries what the conversation changed and nothing else. DEC-TUTORIAL-TRANSPORT-20261106: TALK grants no XP, no turn-in, no chapter unlock and no map movement, so those fields have no place here; appliedFlag may carry only a narrative flag from the pinned catalog. A closed reveal gate answers 409 invalid_transition with fieldErrors naming revealGate, never a fabricated quest_not_found. Requests rejected before the session resolves omit sessionId and result.

questId.description: Server-derived from the character's own active attempt. The client never names it.

objectiveId.description: The objective this node commits, or null when the node is pure narrative and owes nothing.

credited.description: True only when the guards passed: boss and fragment and every earlier objective committed, right owner and attempt, map and floor, and 5 WU or less to the NPC anchor.

replayed.description: Dedupe is by character plus quest attempt plus objective and node: the same node on the same attempt credits once even under a different key, so a second call says replayed without a second credit.

appliedFlag.description: A narrative flag from the pinned catalog only.

eventId.description: Deterministic over character, quest attempt, objective and node, so two attempts or two nodes never collide; the packet's old character/quest/NPC/key tuple was not enough to tell them apart.
